description.value: This cross-sectional study examined whether white matter hyperintensity burden and late-life depression were associated with functional BOLD responses during an affective faces and shapes task.

spans.text: We examined the association of WMH burden with the pattern of functional BOLD response during affective processing in late-life depression.

value: high WMH burden in late-life depression is associated with greater BOLD response on the affective-reactivity task
